summary:
--- PART 1/4 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report — "The measured parent behavior probes helps know parent." and "The parent's weakness is recovery from TFT-like opponents that start with defections."
STRATEGY: The parent starts C, retaliates to defections, forgives sometimes, and defects near the end against all-C. The trace simulates the parent against one_D_TFT, four_D_TFT, four_D_ALLC, sustained_D, and periodic_D, finding poor recovery against TFT-like opponents and over-forgiveness against sustained_D. It proposes changes: contrite TFT (forgive if our t-2 was D and opponent has cooperated recently), never forgive opponents with zero cooperation, and test-and-exploit against non-retaliatory cooperators.

--- PART 2/4 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report — "Let's check the measured parent behavior against four_D_ALLC: parent recovers and scores 2.679. That's near 3.0. Against one_D_TFT, parent scores 2.5. So fixing one_D_TFT could bring it to ~2.96. Against four_D_TFT, parent scores 2.175. Fixing could bring to ~3.0."
STRATEGY: The parent is a cautious TFT-like strategy that starts cooperating, retaliates to defections, forgives when it provoked retaliation, and only exploits all-C at the endgame. The trace simulates the parent against periodic_D, one_D_TFT, four_D_TFT, sustained_D, and four_D_ALLC, and designs a revised strategy adding a mutual-defection test and apology logic to recover from initial defections while avoiding exploitation by unconditional defectors.

--- PART 3/4 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report — "Parent got 2.175. And we didn't need to mark ALLD." / "Parent got 0.729. So about the same." / "Parent got 2.679. Improvement."
STRATEGY: Parent is a TFT-with-apology strategy that forgives only when the opponent has recently cooperated. The trace simulates it against one_D_TFT, four_D_TFT, four_D_ALLC, sustained_D, and periodic_D, then adds a one-time reconciliation test after a mutual-defection streak of 3 or more, switching to permanent defection if the test fails and to TFT-with-apology if it succeeds. It also considers always defecting on the final round.

--- PART 4/4 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report — "The probe four_D_ALLC is an opponent that starts with 4 D then all C. Against that, our strategy got 2.91, while parent got 2.679. So we are doing better."
STRATEGY: Parent defects from round 96 against all-C opponents and otherwise uses TFT-with-apology; the trace simulates one_D_TFT, four_D_TFT, four_D_ALLC, sustained_D, periodic_D, and ALLD; it adds a last-round defection and allows repeated DD-streak tests.
